name: Neighbor's Wife
source:
A lady with a good physique.
Lives in a residence downstairs from [url=/c10670]the protagonist[/url]'s apartment.
She is like an aunt for Ann. The madam is a good person who can not leave a person in trouble, she is as kind to Ann as her parents were when they were alive.
Her husband passed away 10 years ago.
Sentimental and soft-hearted.
Good at cooking roasted pig.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/sikkoku/t_top.html]the official website[/url].]
